# Localizer

Localizer is an MIT-licensed, open-source localization workflow for iOS projects.

## Current behavior

- The local dashboard and CLI work together during development without an account.
- Source files remain under CLI control in the target repository.
- The dashboard receives normalized localization data and returns reviewed translation data.
- `sync` writes `Localizer/Generated/Localizer.xcstrings` in the target repository.
- The current scanner intentionally supports common SwiftUI string literals. A normalized manifest can cover more complex source.

## Important boundaries

- No hosted authentication, remote repository import, automatic translation, or pull-request automation is implemented.
- The dashboard is desktop-only. Public marketing and policy routes are responsive.
- Do not treat prototype dashboard screens as production capabilities.
